national_law.name: Loi relative a la resilience des infrastructures critiques et au renforcement de la cybersecurite
national_law.formal_citation: Projet de loi relatif a la resilience des infrastructures critiques et au renforcement de la cybersecurite
national_law.official_gazette: Journal Officiel de la Republique Francaise
national_law.status_note: Senate adopted March 12, 2025. National Assembly special commission adopted September 17, 2025. Plenary debate not yet scheduled. Expected adoption and publication Q1-Q2 2026, possibly delayed to July 2026.

legislative_timeline.event: Senate adopted the bill in first reading
Senate Special Commission report No. 393 published
Senate adopted the bill in plenary session
European Commission sent reasoned opinion for failure to transpose
National Assembly special commission unanimously adopted the text
Expected: Loi Resilience signed and published in Journal Officiel (delayed)
Expected: ANSSI to release implementing decrees (decrets d'application)

competent_authority.name: Agence nationale de la securite des systemes d'information
competent_authority.role: Central national cybersecurity authority, entity list management, enforcement oversight, incident treatment, threat monitoring

scope.estimated_entities: ~15,000 essential and important entities (up from ~500 under NIS1)
scope.territorial_collectivities: ~1,500 collectivites territoriales and higher education establishments

essential_entities.description: Entities in highly critical sectors with 250+ employees or EUR 50M+ revenue or EUR 43M+ assets

important_entities.description: Entities in critical/highly critical sectors with 50+ employees or EUR 10M+ revenue

incident_reporting.note: Expected to align with NIS2 standard upon adoption

penalties.note: To be specified in final law and implementing decrees

expected.essential_entities: Up to EUR 10,000,000 or 2% of global annual turnover
expected.important_entities: Up to EUR 7,000,000 or 1.4% of global annual turnover

cyber_threat_context.anssi_2024_stats: 218 cyber incidents affecting territorial collectivities (18/month avg)

infringement_proceedings.status: Reasoned opinion sent; legislative process ongoing
